To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. The quality of a software system is determined by its internal quality attributes.
1. The quality of the product is determined by the software product attributes.
The use of a computer system is the only way to measure quality in use.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of software in use, as perceived by the user.
quality in use, the effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction with which users can achieve their goals.
the relationship between quality in use, the software product and the development process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Quality in use is the extent to which an interactive product enables users to achieve their goals in particular situations.
quality in use is the extent to which specified users can effectively, efficiently and satisfactorily achieve specified goals in a specified environment when interacting with a product.
quality is the extent to which the product is effective, efficient and satisfying in meeting the needs of specified users in a specified environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the quality of the product can be improved by the use of a user-centred design process.
we have shown that the use of the term "quality" is not a problem in itself, but the problem is that it is used in different ways.
quality is a characteristic of a product or service that bears on its ability to serve a purpose.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of a product is determined by the user's experience of using it, rather than by its intrinsic properties.
the quality of the software product is a function of the quality of the requirements. If the requirements do not meet user needs
